name: Nisith Raj

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nitish Raj is a literary critic and author whose work spans editorial practice and support for fellow writers through Literia Insight and The Literary Mirror. NIT Jalandhar’s creative-writing course programme lists him as the author of Love in Modern Times and a resource person for its January 2024 course.

His poem ‘Miraculous Tone’ centres on the consolation of hearing a beloved voice. Repeated questions carry the speaker between remembered closeness and the wish to feel wanted again. The telephone conversation becomes an intimate space in which sound can briefly reach across absence.
